messages:
maria.k: Heads-up — regen CI flagged a typegen diff for the onboard-demo/sample-app and the changelog semver in the publish step looks wrong. Not sure if auth/retry tweak caused it.
regen-bot: CI: typegen-regendiff failed (exit 1) on commit 3f9b7a2 — files changed: packages/sample-app/src/types.ts
sam: Can you paste the regendiff output? quick glance might help.
maria.k: sure, running locally now. command I used: `yarn workspace sample-app run regen-types`
maria.k: regendiff snippet: 
```
- export type ApiClient = { request(options: RequestOptions): Promise<Response> }
+ export type ApiClient = { request(options: RequestOptions, opts?: RetryOptions): Promise<Response> }
```
sam: ah ok — RetryOptions got surfaced in typegen after the auth/retry refactor. That is a breaking type-level change (minor) but we never updated package.json semver/publish config.
tyler: Oof — auth/retry change was intended to be additive but we accidentally exported RetryOptions in the API surface. Should be internal.
jen: Where is the changelog bump coming from? CI is looking for a minor bump but package.json still shows patch.
kevin: I think our release script tries to infer the semver level from the regendiff labels (our type-only rules treat exported type additions as minor). But the changelog generator is only scanning commit messages — mismatch.
maria.k: Repro steps for me: pull main, `yarn`, `yarn workspace sample-app run regen-types`, `git status` shows modified types.ts, `yarn run lint` clean. No runtime changes.
sam: Short-term fix: pin the typegen version to pre-auth-retry in sample-app so CI passes while we sort semantic classification.
tyler: Longer-term: change typegen rule to treat purely additive types that don't affect runtime as patch (we need consensus). Also hide RetryOptions behind internal export so it doesn't leak.
jen: Can we add a temp rule to the release workflow: if regendiff only touches `types.ts` in sample apps, treat as patch and auto-stage the regen commit?
kevin: I don't love auto-staging, but we can add a lint gate that fails CI unless a regen commit is included. For now I'll open a quick PR that pins typegen and adds a clear TODO.
kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/482 — pins @redwood/typegen@1.4.2 and adds a CI comment explaining the auth/retry delta.
maria.k: Thanks. I'll revert my local regen and wait for PR to land, then re-run with updated typegen and confirm.
sam: Follow-up action items: 1) tyler to propose internal vs exported type policy; 2) eng-devex to reconcile changelog-semver heuristics (jen/kevin); 3) add a short note in the onboarding docs about regen workflow.
tyler: I'll draft the policy and ping you all in #eng-runtime.
jen: filing a small ticket to adjust changelog scanner to include regendiff heuristics: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/DX-927-regendiff-changelog-heuristics
maria.k: Filed and linked in the PR.
kevin: merging the pin PR in a few minutes once CI green. :thumbsup:
maria.k: :relieved: thanks everyone — will re-run and report back if anything else pops up.
